subject: AuthZ litmus + evidence playbook request — MedSys SOC2 intake
messages:
From: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medsyshealth.com>
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 readiness — MedSys

Hi Vanessa,

Thanks for taking this — MedSys is kicking off a SOC 2 readiness review and the audit team asked us to collect a focused bundle of IAM evidence. Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide: 

- SCIM delta export (example delta for one user + mapping of attributes)
- SAML assertion samples for normal login + MFA step (redacted PII is fine)
- RBAC role-to-permission mapping and service accounts inventory (last 90 days)
- Access snapshot / entitlement export as of 2026-06-01

Target turnaround from our side is 2 weeks; if you need more time let us know and we can set a milestone. Also open to a 30-min call to align expected formats.

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Johnson
Director, Compliance
MedSys Health
compliance@medsyshealth.com

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medsyshealth.com>
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:01:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 readiness — MedSys

Hi Alex —

Appreciate the details. We can provide the items you listed. Proposed plan:

1) Deliver a scoping checklist + expected filename/format within 1 business day.
2) Provide SAML assertion samples (redacted) and a short mapping doc within 5 business days.
3) Deliver SCIM delta sample and an access snapshot export (2026-06-01) within 7 business days.
4) RBAC role map and service account inventory within 10 business days.

I'll loop in our IAM owners to assign artifacts and confirm timing. Can we schedule a quick 30-min alignment at 11:00 AM PT tomorrow? If that doesn't work, I can send a detailed playbook and artifacts checklist instead.

Attached: "initial-evidence-checklist.pdf" (stub) and a link to our shared collection (see below).

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance (Sales Eng)
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments: initial-evidence-checklist.pdf (application/pdf, 45KB)
Related link: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MedSys-IAM-Evidence-Playbook

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 10:14:00 -07:00
Subject: MedSys SOC2 intake — owner assign + artifact list

Team — forwarding MedSys ask. They want a compact bundle for SOC2 readiness. Quick owner assignments please:

- SCIM delta export & attribute mapping -> Priyom
- SAML assertion samples (interactive + MFA) -> Sean
- RBAC role map + service account inventory -> Vanessa (will coordinate with Product infra)
- Access snapshot 2026-06-01 -> Priyom (export)

Requested delivery windows: 5–10 business days depending on artifact. MedSys prefers a single ZIP and a short README.md that explains redaction and sampling methodology.

Notes / constraints:
- Redaction: don't include cleartext emails or employee SSNs in samples; replace with tokenized placeholders.
- SCIM: provide one delta spanning a create->modify->delete cycle if possible.
- RBAC: include role owners and last modification timestamps.

I created JIRA-REQ-4589 to track and uploaded the initial checklist to the drive link. If either of you needs help extracting from the production snapshot, I can request a limited export from infra, but that may need an approval window of 24 hours.

Thanks — aiming to have a draft bundle by 2026-06-18.

Vanessa

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai
To: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: MedSys SOC2 intake — owner assign + artifact list

Sounds good. I'll pull 3 SAML assertion samples (interactive login, SSO via IdP, post-MFA) from staging and sanitize the NameID and any PII. Will place samples as saml_assertion_samples.txt in the share and include a short README of the fields and what was redacted.

Priyom — can you confirm whether you can produce the SCIM delta CSV and the access_snapshot_20260601.json by EOD 2026-06-17? If infra export is needed, ping me and I'll coordinate the request.

— Sean

From: vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai
To: Alex Johnson <alex.johnson@medsyshealth.com>, MedSys Compliance <compliance@medsyshealth.com>
Cc: sean_gallagher@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 11 Jun 2026 15:48:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: IAM evidence for SOC 2 readiness — MedSys

Alex —

Thanks for the quick turnaround on requirements. Confirming our delivery plan and artifacts: 

- scim_delta_sample.csv (sample delta: create -> modify -> deactivate), redacted
- saml_assertion_samples.txt (three samples: interactive, idp-initiated, post-MFA; NameID and emails anonymized)
- rbac_role_map_v1.xlsx (role -> permissions -> owner -> last_modified)
- access_snapshot_20260601.json (entitlements export, role bindings, account types)
- README.md (explains sampling and redaction approach)

Target timeline: draft bundle by 2026-06-18, finalized by 2026-06-21. We will share via the Drive link and upload the ZIP to JIRA-REQ-4589. If you prefer a short call to walk through fields, happy to do 30 minutes next week — let me know availability.

Vanessa Ortiz
Senior Manager, Security & Compliance (Sales Eng)
Redwood Inference
vanessa_ortiz@redwood.ai

Attachments (to be uploaded): scim_delta_sample.csv, saml_assertion_samples.txt, rbac_role_map_v1.xlsx, access_snapshot_20260601.json
Related links: https://drive.redwood.com/shared/MedSys-IAM-Evidence-Playbook, JIRA-REQ-4589
